why: Tests round for the two close-path bugs that only law E1 (a visual law, never run on a pull request) had caught, in next/. The process table walk now also asks held(session) of every state it reaches, with a pinned case for the bug (a watch on a process that started, then exited), in next/packages/libfabrika/src/processes/internal/processTable.laws.test.ts. A new law, next/packages/libfabrika/src/cloudflare/leave.laws.test.ts, boots the real Project over in-memory SQLite, watches its boot process for several window sessions through the door's own monitor, exits it once, and closes sessions by calling the Project's leave on a fresh runtime with no caller's span, as the brain's object does. Both run in the next project, so every pull request runs them. Plants, each run once and undone: leave put back to Effect.fnUntraced makes the leave law fail with NoSuchElementError in its exit; the held filter without isLive makes the leave law and four process table laws fail, the pinned case alone included. With the fix both files pass, 7 of 7.
